description: WRITE (safe): create a DRAFT post for a brand. Drafts are never picked up by the publisher, so nothing goes live; a human approves in the dashboard or promotes it later with schedule_post. scheduled_date is a proposed slot (default: 7 days out).

caption.description: Post body. Omit to inherit the brand's taglines.

platform.description: Target platform, e.g. youtube, tiktok, instagram

reply_text.description: Follow-up reply posted under the main post. On X this is where a link belongs: a URL in the post body costs up to 94% of the reach (near-total on a non-Premium account), while the same URL one reply down costs nothing. Omit to reply with the brand's CTA url; pass an empty string for no reply at all. Ignored by every platform except X.

skip_hashtags.description: true = publish the caption as-is with NO brand hashtags appended; false = always append them. Omit to auto-detect: long hand-authored captions (>280 chars, no '#') skip hashtags. The result's hashtagsSkipped shows the decision.

name: create_draft
